name: Cover-Recursive Peripheral Partial Cubes Are Not One-Point-Amalgam Closed
statement: Two cover-recursively peripheral partial cubes can have a one-point amalgam outside the class, even when both factors are gated in the output.
proof: The rooted factor $\mathcal L_4$ is cover-recursively peripheral but is root-critical at $0^4$. The rooted-wedge theorem therefore makes the one-point amalgam of two copies pc-minimal outside the class.
